text:

subject: Startup Innovation connection - Encord/[COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Thanks for visiting our website - great to meet you.

I lead enterprise partnerships at Encord (YC company;100M series C), where
I work closely with innovation and technical teams supporting them to
explore how to move AI/ML use cases from idea to production.

A common challenge we see in large organisations is that multimodal data
(video, images, sensor data) is often siloed or difficult to operationalise
- which slows down promising AI initiatives. We support teams in
structuring and preparing this data to unlock use cases like computer
vision based automated inspection, anomaly detection, and robotics & more
<[LINK]>-
working with companies such as Boston Dynamics, AbbVie, or AXA.

I'd be really interested to hear what kinds of AI or data-driven
initiatives you're currently exploring at [COMPANY], and see if there's any
overlap where we could support.

Would you be open to connect with us next week?

subject: [COMPANY] & Encord - GTC follow-up
text:
Hi [NAME],

I swung your GTC booth last week - didn't catch anyone on the data side, so
wanted to reach out.

I'm at Encord (Series C, ML DataOps platform) - we're the training data
layer for teams building proprietary models.

I'd imagine scaling Polaris across 40+ languages while spinning up a vision
workload is exactly the point where data infrastructure becomes the
bottleneck.

subject: Encord & SoundHound - GTC follow-up
text:
Hi [NAME],

I stopped by the SoundHound booth at GTC last week and was genuinely
impressed by the on-device multimodal demo.

I'm at Encord (Series C, ML DataOps Paltfrom). Given your work on the
Polaris ASR model and now the push into Vision AI, I'd imagine the data
annotation and curation infrastructure is becoming a real constraint,
especially when you're fine-tuning across 40+ languages and spinning up a
new modality at the same time.

We work with teams like Speechmatics and Kyutai at exactly this point. The
core value is structured annotation pipelines, active learning to cut
labelling volume, and the data quality tooling that model performance at
your scale actually demands.

Would you be open to a 25-minute call to compare notes?

subject: Encord x Obvio
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the move to Obvio!

Since you know Encord well, I wanted to share how we helped Motive get
better model outcomes with less, higher-quality video data. Their main pain
point was annotation tooling eating up too much engineering bandwidth.

Sounds like it could resonate with a high-velocity team like yours. We're
also helping other leading companies like Flock Safety and Nexar with:

   - Model-assisted labelling to cut repetitive work
   - Unified curation + annotation to reduce tooling overhead
   - Analytics to track data quality and efficiency

Worth a quick chat this week? Wednesday and Friday afternoon are currently
open.
